messages.複数の敵を斬りながら、的中のたびに体力の低い味方2名を回復する、暴食の斬撃広域・: A multi-target Gluttony Slash healing E.G.O that cuts down multiple enemies while healing the 2 allies with the lowest HP on each hit.
messages.的中ごとの回復: 的中時に現体力の比率が最も低い味方2名を、最大値の10%(解析: **Healing per hit**: On hit, heals the 2 allies with the lowest current HP ratio by 10% of max HP (12% at Threadspin Ⅲ, 15% at Ⅳ). The more targets it hits, the more the healing stacks.
messages.広域: 攻撃加重値は3。自分の体力が50%未満なら、解析Ⅲで+1、解析Ⅳで+2に: **Multi-target**: Attack Weight is 3. If his HP is below 50%, +1 at Threadspin Ⅲ and +2 at Ⅳ.
messages.破裂: 的中時に破裂3を付与する(解析Ⅲまでは表面的中時のみ)。: **Rupture**: Inflicts 3 Rupture on hit (only on Heads Hit through Threadspin Ⅲ).
messages.威力は低め: マッチ威力18~24の1コインで、強敵の大技に合わせるには向かない: **Lowish power**: A single Coin with Clash Power 18–24, not suited to matching strong enemies' big attacks.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 体力が最も高い対象を狙い、与えたダメージの一部で自分を回復する。解: **Corrosion skill**: Targets the highest-HP target and heals himself with part of the damage dealt. From Threadspin Ⅲ, it also inflicts Defense Level Down.
messages.3体以上を巻き込める場面で、体力が減った味方をまとめて回復する。: In situations where it can catch 3 or more enemies, heal multiple damaged allies at once.
messages.資源は色欲1・暴食4・傲慢2と重いので、資源を自給できる人格で使う。精神消耗は覚: Its resources are a heavy 1 Lust, 4 Gluttony, and 2 Pride, so use it with Identities that can supply them. Sanity cost is 25 for Awakening and 30 for Corrosion.
messages.回復目当てなら、体力50%未満の強化は後回しでも使える。: If healing is the goal, the below-50%-HP bonus can wait.
messages.Ⅱ: 「好餌妖精」が解放される。効果は条件が厳しく、小さな補助にとどまる。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Fairy Lure. Its condition is strict, so it is only a small supplement.
messages.Ⅲ: 回復が12%になり、体力50%未満で加重値+1。: **Ⅲ**: Healing becomes 12%, with +1 Attack Weight below 50% HP.
messages.Ⅳ: 回復が15%、体力50%未満で加重値+2になり、破裂が的中時に付く。強化は: **Ⅳ**: Healing becomes 15%, +2 Attack Weight below 50% HP, and Rupture applies on hit. The upgrades pay off when his HP is low.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::紅籍: S1(暴食)・S2(傲慢)・S3(色欲)で必要資: **[Lobotomy E.G.O::Red Sheet](persona:1006)**: S1 (Gluttony), S2 (Pride), and S3 (Lust) cover all required affinities, and he also inflicts Rupture.
messages.南部センク協会4課部長: S1(暴食)・S2(傲慢)・S3(色欲)で必要資源を自: **[Cinq Assoc. South Section 4 Director](persona:1008)**: S1 (Gluttony), S2 (Pride), and S3 (Lust) supply the required affinities himself.
